grid.origin: top-left, col 0..5, row 0..5, flow goes down (row increasing)

presetLanesNote: [row, col]; col 1 and col 3 are two narrow lanes, col 2 rock between them

exit.note: any cargo leaving row 5 downward exits

failJamWide.en: Gate {gate} jammed by a wide load

failJamWideHint.zh: 宽货要一整条两格宽的道，从上通到底
failJamWideHint.en: Wide loads need a 2-wide lane all the way down

failJamHint.zh: 货进不来了：腾出路，或换一条走
failJamHint.en: Cargo can't get in: clear a path

clearGraceRule: if any cargo remains on board or in a queue when clearGraceSec ends, fail with strings.failClear

rulesV11.erode: player-dug lane cells (not presetLanes) collapse to rock after erodeIdleSec with no cargo on them; crack visual erodeWarnSec before; collapse refunds quota; cells with a queued or in-progress action never collapse; a cell's idle timer resets whenever any cargo (narrow or either half of a wide) occupies it, and starts when it is dug; a cell does not count idle while any cargo is in the same column at a higher row (prevents dead-end traps)
rulesV11.wideJitter: each wide spawn time = atSec + uniform(-wideJitterSec, +wideJitterSec), drawn once per run from a seed; preview starts widePreviewSec before the jittered time; debug panel shows seed and can lock it; the jittered time is snapped to a multiple of wideJitterStepSec (0.5 s) before use
rulesV11.noGrace: no hidden grace for any cargo; a cargo's 20 s timer runs from birth including queue time (firstWideGraceSec = 0)
rulesV11.tapCancel: tapping a cell that already has a queued or in-progress action cancels that action (intended)
rulesV11.failOrder: if failA and failB conditions hit on the same tick, failA wins (unchanged in M1)
